encoder: legalese-sonnet-5.5: one Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone, solo, no sub-agents
display_name: BKV § 9(5) with IFG § 1(1) and § 3 no. 4, access to the Council's papers: a law layer, a seat for the requester, and the Art. 80(1) sentence 3 citation test
seat: a person who asks a federal authority for a document about the Expert Advisory Council on Occupational Diseases, asking whether they are entitled to access under the Freedom of Information Act and whether § 9(5) BKV makes the document confidential.
edition: BKV §§ 8, 9, Eingangsformel; IFG §§ 1, 3; SGB VII § 9; Grundgesetz Art. 80, as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02; BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 210 (gazette text and PDF); Bundesrat Drucksache 312/26; Bundestag Drucksache 19/17586 pp. 101-102; BVerwG 7 C 4.11; BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90 paras. 151 to 158 (../../registers/source-bundle/).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The consolidated texts are the site's reading versions; the Seventh Amending Regulation and the Drucksache were read from their own texts. Bundestag document 19/17586 (pp. 101 to 102) and BVerwG 7 C 4.11 (paras. 29 to 34) were read as excerpts; the full earlier wording of § 9(5) sentence 2 is not deposited. The tests' expected values were written by the encoder from the text, not by an independent author.

check_sh_output: target: main. Each module is run with your l4 and with the main build below; the main columns must match.
module                                    errors satisfied  failed  refused  expected | errors satisfied  failed  refused  main
(a failed assertion is also an error; any other error, or any refused assertion, makes the run red)

(target main: every module has the same four counts on the main build. That rules out a module main rejects and a difference an assertion shows; it does not see a different TRACE outcome, or any difference no assertion exercises)

scope.intent: BKV § 9(5) sentences 1 to 3; IFG § 1(1) and § 3 no. 4; SGB VII § 9(1a) sentence 4 as the power needed; the preambles of the BKV and the Seventh Amending Regulation; Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3 as the citation test. Not the rest of the Regulation, the Act, or the other grounds for refusal in the IFG.
